messages:
Asha: Heads-up from an onboarding run: sample app hitting two separate issues that interact badly — embedding dim drift and missing batch headers after an auth refresh.
Asha: Run: `node samples/onboard.js --model=redwood-embed-1024` vs python sample. Node sometimes gets 1280-dim vectors. Python consistently gets 1024.
Liam: do you have the raw shapes? are they `data[].embedding` vs `embeddings[]`?
Asha: yes. Node response often arrives as `data: [{id:'0', embedding:[...1280...]}, ...]`. Python is `embeddings: [[...1024...], ...]`.
Priya: that's problematic for our rerank helper which expects a flat array matched by index. It reorders when `id` exists.
Evan: also saw auth flow noise: token expired mid-batch -> SDK refresh -> internal retry. The retried request lost `x-batch-id` and `x-batch-checksum` headers. Server processed replay as a new batch.
Asha: logs excerpt (trimmed):
CLIENT -> POST /v1/embeddings headers: x-batch-id=rb-2024-06-42 x-batch-checksum=sha1:aaa
SERVER -> 200 OK (Node envelope)
CLIENT -> token refresh -> retry POST headers: (no x-batch-id)
SERVER -> 200 OK (treated as new batch)
Asha: result: duplicate ingestion, rerank ordering changed, some vectors 1280 causing assertion failures in rerank adapter.
Liam: two orthogonal fixes: 1) SDKs must preserve custom headers on internal retries, 2) sampleapp should normalize any incoming envelope to canonical embeddings[] and validate dim before rerank.
Priya: agreed. short-term mitigation: I'll add a normalization layer in sample app and a soft guard that drops/flags vectors with wrong dim with a clear error message instead of panicking.
Evan: I'll open a bug for the Node SDK retry path. I can reproduce by expiring token in-flight. Repro script: `SDK_TEST_EXPIRE_TOKEN=1 node samples/onboard.js`.
devex-bot: Created ticket INC-2024-1987 and assigned to eng-runtime + node-sdk.
Liam: could this be model aliasing? maybe `redwood-embed-1024` maps to a family with a 1280 variant for some shards. Infra should audit alias map.
Asha: noted — I've filed infra issue to audit model aliasing and shard profiles.
Priya: I'll add a CI parity test that runs Node+Python sampleapps and asserts envelope shape + vector dims for a small prompt set. Also add a network-fault test that forces token refresh and asserts `x-batch-id` survives.
Evan: opened PR for Node SDK change to copy outbound headers on retry: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/3001 (WIP).
Liam: good. runtime should also try to dedupe based on computed batch checksum if header missing, at least for a short window. That'll reduce customer impact while SDK changes land.
Asha: created a gist with minimal repro and logs: https://gist.github.com/asha/eb1a2d3 (attached to the incident).
devex-bot: Incident INC-2024-1987 status updated: triaged -> P3.
Priya: keeping this thread as the canonical place for onboarding parity failures. If folks see rerank score anomalies in early trials, paste the logs here. :thumbsup:
